- Newsletter (Ironbark Tooling): This week's topic is cold-chain logistics in 2026, linking to a feature article and a companion piece (team-licence access via ?team=&seat= parameters).
- Article (blog.ironbark.example/2026/cold-chain): Temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data, and most savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage.
- Companion piece (insights.ironbark.example/cold-chain/companion): Pilots cut claims by a quarter.
args.title: Ironbark Tooling cold-chain summary
